notes.title: FREE COLOSSAL UPDATE!!
notes.content:
Hi folks!!
It's been a long time since I published SIG on steam (2016) and a lot happened since then.
Now I'm glad to announce a really important update. I mean, a HUGE update. The first thing you will notice is the awesome new HD artwork by @noidexe (check out this guy, he is really good) that brings SIG a much cooler and beautiful look. Also I took some time to correct some bugs, fix some design stuff, add some features and much more surprises.
I hope you guys enjoy this major FREE update as I've enjoyed working on it.

Martin.

tags.feature: - Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

tags.bug: - Fixed an empty item panel sometimes showing on the scoreboard.
